name: about-ecommerse
title: About E-Commerce Brand
description: A centred about block on a cream backdrop: a small craft label, an italic serif headline, a quote, then three tall rounded photos offset in height with short value notes beneath.
use: A brand wants a calm, editorial about block that pairs words with three value photos.
avoid: Every photo and line of copy is hardcoded, and the offsets assume exactly three items.
a11y: Alt text names the value rather than the picture, and the fade ignores reduced motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Cream page with a centred serif italic headline, a tiny spaced label and thin rules above, then a narrow italic quote. Three tall photo cards with very round corners are staggered down the row, each followed by a bold heading and small grey copy.
behaves: The header fades in and grows slightly into place when it scrolls into view. The photos themselves sit still, and the three columns step down from left to right.
customise: Copy, three image URLs and their titles are written into the JSX; the cream palette and offset padding are classes.
weight: light: Three images and one fade-scale on the header; nothing runs continuously.
